title: A published Space website looks like a website: a full-width cover, a menu of the Space's own sections with a Book button, a real footer, and the Space page's column width

source.ref: Owner review of danieltyack.com 2026-10-06: 'it looks like trash. Let's make the header image full width. Create a header menu related to the features of the space. Create a site footer as well. The width of the center column should be the same as the site page.' Plus 'Make Frequency Partner a clickable logo / text'. White label sites build ADR-1708

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-06. THE CONSEQUENCE: the first live client site (danieltyack.com) rendered as the app's Space page in a thin frame: a boxed cover card, a header with only the brand, a one-line footer, so it read as an app page rather than a business website. THE FIX: the Website state only (the visitor and logged-in Space pages are untouched). SiteHero is a full-width cover at the saved focal point with the name, tagline and a Book button. The header menu is built from the blocks placed on Home (components/sites/site-nav.ts maps block ids to section anchors the blocks already render, and :has() CSS hides a link whose section rendered empty, so no client JS), plus the Space's other pages and a Book button when a booking block is placed; on a phone it folds into a details disclosure. The footer has the brand and tagline, the same links, contact details and social links, and a Frequency Partner logo plus text linking to frequencylocal.com. Home's rows render as full-width section bands (EntityGrid gains an optional wrapRow) on one shared 66rem column, the Space page's own center column, and a band whose blocks all rendered empty collapses.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const c=r('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx');const p=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx');const n=r('components/sites/site-nav.ts');if(!/export function siteSectionLinks\(/.test(n)||!/sections=\{siteSectionLinks\(/.test(p))miss.push('the website header has no menu built from the Space blocks');if(!/function SiteHero\(/.test(p)||!/sizes=|w-full/.test(p)||/<DetailTemplate/.test(p))miss.push('the website still uses the boxed app cover instead of a full-width hero');if(!/Get in touch/.test(c)||!/Frequency Partner/.test(c)||!/icons\/icon\.svg/.test(c))miss.push('the website footer has no contact column or no Frequency Partner logo link');if(!/max-w-\[66rem\]/.test(c))miss.push('the website column does not match the Space page center column');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-811: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (no site-nav, DetailTemplate cover, one-line footer, max-w-6xl column); passes once the redesign lands.
